name: psao-artifact
description: Instrumentation and scenario services for the PSAO reproducibility artifact. The microbenchmark has its own manifest in bench/.
_note_prom_client: prom-client 15.x prints a deprecation notice pointing at @prometheus-io/client, its renamed successor. We stay on prom-client because that is what the paper's instrumentation is specified against and what the deployed images use; the API is the same if you migrate. See the comment in scenarios/s9-cluster-mode.js about the AggregatorRegistry constructor, which is required for cluster-mode metrics to work at all.
